events.name: Edgardo Nuñez & Kane Rodriguez
events.info: Edgardo Nuñez is a prominent Regional Mexican singer, songwriter, and accordionist. Known for leading a new generation of corridos and ballads. Recognized for hits like "Billete Grande" and "El Ruddy," he blends traditional Mexican sounds with urban sensibilities, amassing nearly 13 million monthly Spotify listeners. Kane Rodriguez is a rising Houston-born Mexican regional singer-songwriter known for his viral TikTok hits, raw lyrics, and blending cumbia, banda, and norteño with modern sensibilities. Emerging from a musical family, he gained massive popularity in 2024, releasing hits like "On D Gas" and his 2025 debut album La Batuta.

events.info: Jonathan Van Ness is an Emmy-winning television personality, 3x New York Times best-selling author, podcaster, comedian, celebrity hairstylist, and founder of JVN Hair. He stars on Netflix?s Emmy Award-winning reboot series ?Queer Eye,? where he shines as the hair guru and self-care advocate. Jonathan also starred on the Emmy-nominated web series ?Gay of Thrones,? a witty social commentary series recapping HBO?s ?Game of Thrones.? Fresh off two successful worldwide comedy tours, Jonathan Van Ness: Road to Beijing and Imaginary Living Room Olympian, which sold out theaters in 40 cities in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand, Jonathan is bringing their new show, Hot & Healed, to cities around the US, Canada and abroad. Unfiltered comedy, wildly entertaining and fun, the show is a celebration of joy and a showcase for all the sides of JVN you have never seen before.
